name: Japan
description: Japan pairs precise, efficient cities with a living tradition of shrines, temples and seasonal ritual. Bullet trains link neon-lit Tokyo with the wooden temples and gardens of Kyoto, and hot-spring inns in the mountains offer a slower, more contemplative way to travel.

name: Thailand
description: Thailand moves easily between gilded royal temples, forested northern hills and a southern coast of limestone islands rising from warm green water. Its gracious service, refined cuisine and superb hotels make it one of Asia's most rewarding and relaxed destinations.

name: France
description: France moves easily between grand cities, royal palaces and quiet countryside, linked by some of Europe's fastest trains. Paris sets the tone with its museums and boulevards, while Normandy's coast and the sunlit Riviera show how much the landscape and the light change within a single journey.

name: Italy
description: Italy layers ancient Rome, Renaissance Florence and the canals of Venice within a few hours of each other by high-speed rail. Between the cities lie cliff-edge coastlines and lakes, and everywhere the pace is set by long lunches, evening walks and a deep pride in regional food.

name: Switzerland
description: Switzerland is a compact country of high peaks, clear lakes and punctual mountain railways that reach remarkable altitudes. Car-free villages, lakeside towns and panoramic trains make it easy to see glaciers and summits in comfort, with a calm, orderly rhythm to every day.

name: South Africa
description: South Africa pairs world-class wildlife reserves and the dramatic landscapes of the Cape with renowned coastal vineyards, luxury private lodges, and scenic ocean drives where two oceans meet.

name: Morocco
description: Morocco is an intoxicating world of imperial cities, labyrinthine spice markets, dramatic Atlas mountain passes, and tranquil oasis riads on the edge of the Sahara dunes.

name: Egypt
description: Egypt offers five millennia of recorded civilization along the life-giving Nile, from the monumental pyramids of Giza and Karnak's columned halls to luxury Nile river cruisers and Red Sea reef sanctuaries.

name: Kenya
description: Kenya is the cradle of the safari, celebrated for the Great Migration across the Masai Mara, snow-capped Mount Kenya vistas, and conservation conservancies that pioneer luxury wilderness journeys.

name: Tanzania
description: Tanzania encompasses the endless plains of the Serengeti, the wildlife caldera of Ngorongoro, the heights of Kilimanjaro, and the spice-scented turquoise waters of Zanzibar.

name: Zimbabwe
description: Zimbabwe is home to the thundering spectacle of Victoria Falls, pristine wilderness parks like Hwange and Mana Pools, and some of the most acclaimed private safari guides in Africa.

name: Tunisia
description: Tunisia bridges Mediterranean elegance with ancient Carthage ruins, golden Roman amphitheaters at El Jem, and whitewashed cliffside coastal villages overlooking cobalt seas.

name: Spain
description: Spain carries eight centuries of Islamic heritage in the south and a restless modern creativity in its cities. Fast trains connect the Moorish palaces of Andalusia with Madrid's great art museums and Barcelona's Gaudí buildings.

name: United Kingdom
description: The United Kingdom packs a thousand years of history into a compact island, from royal fortresses and great museums to Georgian spa towns and wild Scottish coastline.

name: Greece
description: Greece joins the monuments of classical Athens with a scattering of islands in a bright Aegean sea. Whitewashed Cycladic architecture, ancient cliffside monasteries, and secluded bays await.

name: Turkey
description: Turkey spans two continents, and its layers of Byzantine and Ottoman history sit side by side with a lively modern culture, hot-air ballooning over Cappadocia, and classical Aegean coastlines.

name: United Arab Emirates
description: The Emirates pair futuristic architecture with the older rhythms of desert camps and Arabian hospitality. Distances are short, service is polished, and world-class cultural institutions like Louvre Abu Dhabi inspire.

name: Saudi Arabia
description: Saudi Arabia has opened its deserts, ancient kingdoms and coral coast to travellers. Expect Nabataean tombs cut into sandstone at Hegra and ultra-luxury resorts along the Red Sea.

name: Malaysia
description: Malaysia blends diverse cultures, felt clearly in its food, festivals and architecture. Journeys take in glittering skylines, cool tea-covered hills, and quiet tropical islands.

name: Indonesia
description: Indonesia stretches across thousands of tropical islands, from Bali's spiritual sanctuaries and rice terraces to the volcanic plains of Java and dragon-inhabited waters of Komodo.

name: Vietnam
description: Vietnam runs along the eastern edge of Indochina, with limestone seascapes in Halong Bay, lantern-lit trading towns like Hoi An, and refined culinary heritage.

name: South Korea
description: South Korea pairs a high-tech capital with ancient palaces and hanok villages. High-speed rail connects royal Joseon heritage with the volcanic coastlines of Jeju.

name: China
description: China rewards travellers with breathtaking scale: the Great Wall traversing mountain ridges, imperial Forbidden City palaces, and tranquil limestone karst riverways in Guilin.

name: Singapore
description: Singapore is a lush garden city-state where architectural marvels, Michelin gastronomy, and pristine waterfront boardwalks offer effortless luxury.

name: Maldives
description: The Maldives is a private-island archipelago in the Indian Ocean where overwater villas open directly onto vibrant coral lagoons with manta rays and turquoise horizons.

name: Sri Lanka
description: Sri Lanka packs ancient rock fortresses, Buddhist temples, misty Ceylon tea hills and golden southern beaches into an accessible tropical jewel.

name: Austria
description: Austria pairs imperial Habsburg splendour with Alpine tranquility: classical concert halls in Vienna, baroque Salzburg, and pristine mountain lakes.

name: Germany
description: Germany moves between fairytale castles, Rhine vineyard valleys, and vibrant cultural metropolises with rich musical and historical pedigree.

name: Portugal
description: Portugal is sunlit and shaped by the Atlantic, from Lisbon's tiled hills to the terraced Douro vineyards and golden cliffs of the Algarve.

name: Croatia
description: Croatia runs along an azure Adriatic coastline dotted with more than a thousand islands, ancient Roman palaces in Split, and medieval Dubrovnik walls.

name: Georgia
description: Georgia pairs Greater Caucasus snow peaks with ancient Christian monasteries and the oldest winemaking heritage on Earth.

name: Uzbekistan
description: Uzbekistan holds the legendary Silk Road treasures of Samarkand, Bukhara and Khiva with turquoise domes and grand mosaic madrasas.
